cases.sentence: ___ мое твердо, Боже, буду петь и играть душой моей.
cases.explain: Сердце is the grammatical subject, so it takes the nominative case.
Direct object of разбужу takes the accusative case.
The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.
The comparative выше (above) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Над всей ___ да будет слава Твоя.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) governs the instrumental case.
The instrumental case shows the means of action.
The preposition в (into) with accusative indicates direction.
The preposition с (with) governing instrumental indicates association.
